mapper.sql: menu_id, parent_id, path, title, icon, type, sort, status
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.path, m.title, m.icon, m.type, m.sort, m.status FROM t_user_role ur INNER JOIN t_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN t_menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.type IN (1, 2) AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.sort ASC, m.menu_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_menu (parent_id, path, title, icon, type, sort, status) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{path}, #{title}, #{icon}, #{type}, #{sort}, #{status})
